scope: CVG-004 bounded explicit worker report actor configuration, fail-closed entrypoints and operator-managed deployment wiring

criteria.description: The intentional RED reproduced missing worker configuration, absent resolver compilation, account-id fallback persistence behavior and missing Helm identity wiring before implementation.
criteria.limitations: The RED is historical evidence retained for TDD traceability; it is not a current defect claim.

criteria.description: Canonical worker configuration validates one trimmed, non-nil RFC 4122 UUID actor, requires it in production-like environments, and the shared worker resolver rejects missing or malformed values before report execution.
criteria.limitations: The UUID contract identifies a configured actor but does not establish account membership for every worker account.

criteria.description: Continuous and one-shot worker report entrypoints use the same explicit actor resolver and pass the resolved identity as runAsUserId; no account-id report actor fallback remains in these paths.
criteria.limitations: The entrypoint continuity proof is a compiled static wiring assertion plus the real one-shot process; a long-lived deployed continuous-worker run remains outside this local gate.

criteria.description: A disposable PostgreSQL run-once process proves a known explicit actor persists requested_by_user_id, a missing actor exits before scheduling, and an unknown UUID actor fails closed without a report execution row.
criteria.limitations: The database is disposable and local; target roles, remote CI, deployed replicas, distributed worker behavior and external providers are not certified.

criteria.description: Production-like Compose and canonical staging/prod Helm worker deployments require WORKER_REPORTS_USER_ID from operator-managed Secret configuration and do not accept a plaintext chart-values fallback.
criteria.limitations: The Helm binary was unavailable locally; static chart validation passed for dev, staging and prod, but actual rendered manifests and target admission remain unverified. Dev intentionally has no actor and fails closed at worker startup.

criteria.description: Focused and repository quality rails pass for the final bounded implementation, including worker/shared tests, lint, typecheck, build, security/static checks and diff hygiene.
criteria.limitations: Local quality rails do not certify remote CI, target infrastructure, production operations, accessibility, disaster recovery, providers or release acceptance.

criteria.description: A fresh independent read-only review found no Critical or High issue in the bounded slice; remaining Medium/Low findings are either remediated or explicitly retained as residual scope.
criteria.limitations: The review remains conditional because one configured actor is not mapped per account and the existing report execution foreign key does not enforce actor/account membership.

criteria.description: The worker identity result is reconciled without promoting parent CVG-004, Vetus parity, clinical parity, enterprise readiness or release status.
criteria.limitations: General parity remains 98/100 with 4/11 verified, clinical parity 100/100 with 2/3 verified, and enterprise readiness 95/100 with 42 PASS / 3 WARN / 1 FAIL.

gaps: The configured worker actor is not yet resolved through a per-account service-principal mapping; a known user from another account may not be rejected by the existing report_executions user-only foreign key.
The existing report audit model and requested_by_user_id tenant-membership semantics were not changed in this bounded slice.
Dev Helm has no actor Secret by design and the worker fails closed; actual Helm rendering was unavailable because the Helm binary is not installed locally.
Local evidence does not certify target roles/RLS, distributed worker restart/fencing, providers, remote CI, accessibility, backup/restore, parity or release acceptance.
conditions: Keep this result limited to explicit worker report actor configuration, fail-closed entrypoints and operator-managed Compose/Helm wiring.
Obtain new authority before introducing per-account service principals, changing report audit/schema semantics, provisioning credentials, or operating a target/production environment.
Keep parent CVG-004 and the global ERP program IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL regardless of this bounded result.
